sources.entry: Grammarly - AI-powered writing assistant for grammar, style, and clarity. #freemium

summary.name: Grammarly
summary.one_liner: Grammarly is an AI writing assistant that checks grammar, tone and clarity and generates text across apps and websites.
use_cases: adjusting tone for brand or audience
reviewing writing as a reader would
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Grammarly as an AI writing partner that fixes typos, makes sentences more concise, and rephrases text. It offers tone suggestions that aim to keep the user's voice, including inside tools such as a Zendesk text box and to follow a brand style guide. A feature reviews existing text and gives feedback based on various reader reactions. Free individual plan includes writing without mistakes, tone visibility, and 100 AI generation prompts. The Enterprise plan adds unlimited members, unlimited generative AI prompts, confidential mode, granular roles, and data loss prevention, delivered through Superhuman Go.
notable: Works in any app or website, per the meta description and page copy
Free individual plan with 100 AI prompts; Enterprise tier with confidential mode and data loss prevention
States it does not sell user content or let third-party providers train models on user content
caveats: Enterprise pricing is not shown on the page and the Enterprise plan is delivered through Superhuman Go
Advanced features beyond the free plan are implied to be paid, but prices for paid individual plans are not listed in the text
Enterprise ROI figures and testimonials are vendor-supplied marketing claims
